whyThisMatters:
"#1 Platform for Tech Interview Preparation": interview questions, guides, real interview experiences and coaching. You pick the role and company (e.g. ML Engineer at Amazon) and get a personalized plan. Pricing: 29 dollars a month and 89 dollars/year. ~50,000 estimated users; homepage says "48,000+ professionals already prepping". Founded Apr 2023, US. 1,794 active subscriptions.

Like Writing9 for IELTS: an evergreen gate (the tech interview) with a fresh cohort every hiring cycle, sold on SEO for "<company> <role> interview questions". After two flat years it went vertical from June 2026.

You practice the interview before you sit in it. Questions, write-ups, and notes from people who already did the round. The subscription count is large next to a lot of the other notes this week. I am not grading whether the “number one” line on the listing is true. The Stripe number is the part with a date.
